episode_summary: Gwen Snyder shares her journey in luxury real estate, emphasizing the power of relationship building over cold calling. She provides actionable insights on maintaining client relationships, effective marketing strategies, and the importance of personal resilience. Her approach to anticipating client needs and focusing on authentic connections offers a blueprint for agents aiming to build a referral-based business.
